purpose: Independent, source-backed comparison contracts for the real-aircraft presets. Values in this file are evidence anchors; they are never copied from the ALAS model dump.

scope.excluded_preset: AVE is a synthetic ALAS design and has no real-aircraft parity target.

status_semantics.within_tolerance: A source-backed numeric value and model value are available, the stated condition is matched, and the difference is within the field tolerance. This is a comparison result, not certification validation.
status_semantics.out_of_tolerance: A source-backed numeric value and model value are available under a matched condition and the difference exceeds the field tolerance.
status_semantics.diagnostic: Both values are available, but source evidence is secondary/estimated or the source/model conditions, variant, reference area, or metric definition are not identical. It is excluded from a release score.
status_semantics.unsupported: A source-backed target exists, but the model dump does not export the requested quantity.
status_semantics.evidence_gap: No trustworthy public numeric target exists for the requested quantity or the source explicitly withholds it.
status_semantics.source_conflict: The optional local evidence bundle disagrees with this immutable contract anchor; neither value is used to score the model.

geometry_length.basis: public dimensions are commonly rounded to centimetres or inches

mass_limit.basis: certified variant mass table and conversion rounding

mass_oew.basis: cabin fit and operator equipment make OEW configuration-dependent

performance_ratio.basis: analytical/reference-model spread; always diagnostic unless exact test conditions are supplied

drag_coefficient.basis: reference area and configuration sensitivity; always diagnostic for the current sources

lift_curve_slope.basis: hand-estimated or wing-only references; always diagnostic

mission_fuel.basis: route, reserves, payload and weather differences; always diagnostic

field_length.basis: take-off/landing field lengths read from manufacturer charts (+-2-5 % read uncertainty); chart-read anchors are secondary and never scored

approach_speed.basis: published approach speeds are weight- and configuration-specific and rounded to whole knots

payload_range_nmi.basis: payload-range corners read from charts with a stated reserve basis; the model Breguet range has no reserves

payload_mass.basis: payload at a chart corner read to about +-0.5-2 t

cg_percent_mac.basis: certified or planning CG limits are published to 0.1-1 %MAC

engine_thrust.basis: engine TCDS sea-level static take-off rating per engine

engine_power.basis: engine take-off shaft power per engine

engine_dry_mass.basis: engine TCDS dry weight (basic engine with standard accessories, excluding nacelle)

regulatory.title: Proof of compliance
regulatory.implication: Certification performance and handling requirements must cover each appropriate weight/CG combination, with testing or calculations of test-equivalent accuracy; model parity cannot replace this evidence.

regulatory.title: Weight limits
regulatory.implication: Maximum weights depend on operating, environmental and loading conditions; a single MTOW scalar is not a complete design-space boundary.

regulatory.title: Center of gravity limits
regulatory.implication: Forward and aft CG limits must be established for each practically separable operating condition and bounded by structural and flight compliance evidence.

regulatory.title: Empty weight and corresponding center of gravity
regulatory.implication: OEW/CG needs a repeatable weighed configuration including unusable fuel and operating fluids; an estimated component sum is not a measured OEW/CG.

regulatory.title: General performance conditions
regulatory.implication: Performance comparisons need declared atmosphere, humidity, still-air and applicant-selected configurations, plus repeatable procedures.

regulatory.title: Stall speed
regulatory.implication: VSR is tied to load-factor-corrected CLMAX, weight, reference area, configuration and the CG producing the highest VSR; a generic cruise polar is not a certification stall result.

regulatory.title: Climb: one-engine-inoperative
regulatory.implication: OEI gradients must be checked by engine count and configuration: takeoff gear retracted 2.4/2.7/3.0%, final takeoff 1.2/1.5/1.7%, and approach 2.1/2.4/2.7% for two/three/four engines.

regulatory.title: En-route flight paths
regulatory.implication: OEI en-route paths require the most unfavorable CG, critical engine(s) inoperative and maximum continuous thrust; net reductions are 1.1/1.4/1.6% for two/three/four-engine aircraft.

regulatory.title: Strength and deformation
regulatory.implication: Limit loads may not cause detrimental permanent deformation and ultimate loads require the stated strength/deformation treatment; a SOL101 run needs a defined load case and material/constraint basis.

regulatory.title: Proof of structure
regulatory.implication: Structural analysis is acceptable only where the method is reliable for the structure; otherwise substantiating tests are required for critical loading conditions.

regulatory.title: CS-25 OEI climb
regulatory.implication: EASA CS-25 carries the same engine-count-dependent OEI gradients and expects consideration of the critical CG/trajectory; this is the relevant design-space gate for transport-category presets.
